title: Add prefill heatmap generator and quant-trimmer heuristic
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: Teams tuning prefill and quantization defaults need a compact way to see per-tenant and per-model prefill efficiency and to automatically trim low-impact quantization steps. Motivation: Empirically we saw operators over-prescribe prefill depth and apply full quant schedules even when many models show negligible accuracy impact. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) a prefill heatmap generator that samples traffic and produces tenant/model-level heatmaps showing cold-start penalty vs prefill depth and cost delta; (2) a quant-trimmer heuristic that scans model eval traces and proposes removal of quant steps whose measured quality degradation is below a configurable threshold relative to cost savings. Summary of changes: implemented a new service endpoint /internal/prefill-heatmap that produces a compact JSON heatmap and an optional PNG export; added redwoodctl subcommand prefill-heatmap --tenant <id> --since <iso> to generate and store heatmaps to S3; introduced quant_trimmer module which computes per-layer and per-precision impact scores, a quant_impact_score telemetry metric, and a suggestions API under /optimize/quant-suggestions; wired the suggestions into Redwood Optimize to seed candidate quant profiles; added a safety gate where suggested trims are run in a shadow rollout and validated against a per-prompt regression test set before promotion; added end-to-end tests and telemetry checks. Backwards compatibility and rollout: endpoints are protected under internal feature flags and the CLI is gated behind the Optimize feature flag. No customer-facing API breaking changes. Checklist: 1) Heatmap generator service + endpoint implemented. 2) CLI integration complete with S3 export support. 3) Quant-trimmer algorithm and suggestion API added. 4) Shadow rollout path and regression test harness integrated. 5) Unit and integration tests added. 6) Telemetry metrics and dashboards created (prefill_heatmap_generated, quant_impact_score, quant_suggestion_promoted). Related work: builds on ENG-2250 sampling harness and reuses the workload-sampler from ENG-2400. Linked Linear tasks ENG-2391 and ENG-2400 track follow-ups for UX and autoschedule integration. Impact and rationale: this reduces operator tuning time and yields measurable unit-econ wins in our internal benchmark: average token-cost reduction of 7-11% for tenants with cold-heavy traffic and allows removal of up to 2 quant steps for many medium-sized models without measurable quality loss. Migration notes: operators should run redwoodctl prefill-heatmap for target tenants, inspect heatmaps in console > Optimize > Prefill Insights, and opt-in to quant suggestions via the new Optimize UI toggle. Metrics and dashboards created: Optimize > Prefill heatmap view and Optimize > Quant Suggestions (beta).

review_conversation: Initial review by Ethan asked for clearer threshold semantics and a more conservative default; author updated quant_trimmer to expose quant.trim_threshold_pct with a safe default of 0.6 and added unit tests demonstrating behavior. Marta requested a stronger shadow rollout observability hook; we added quant_suggestion_promoted and quant_suggestion_reverted metrics and a small dashboard. Ravi asked for explicit rate limiting on the heatmap sampling job to avoid production load spikes; implemented rate limiting via the sampling job's token-bucket config and added a CLI flag --rate-limit to redwoodctl. Final approvals after CI pass and after a short canary on staging. Author performed the squash merge after approval with the 'squash' merge method.
release_notes: Introduce Prefill Heatmap tooling and a Quant-Trimmer suggestion engine. Operators can generate tenant heatmaps to visualize prefill vs cost tradeoffs and receive conservative quantization trims to reduce token unit costs. Feature is behind Optimize flags and requires opt-in for auto-promotion.
notes_for_ops: Run redwoodctl prefill-heatmap --tenant <tenant-id> --since 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z to seed heatmap storage. Ensure the Optimize feature flag is enabled for the org before promoting suggestions. Monitor quant_impact_score and quant_suggestion_promoted metrics during canary.
qa_notes: Added replay-based tests that validate no more than 0.5% regression on the configured regression prompt set for promoted quant trims. To reproduce locally run pytest optimize/tests::test_quant_trimmer --snapshot-update to refresh golden baselines.
customer_impact: Low risk internal tool for operators. No API changes for customer traffic. May reduce billing for tenants who opt into suggestions.
